title: 第21章 搜刮物资第22章 都杀了吧
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 神罚，进化点榜第9的强≈x4b7e;。
达到了9127的超高进化点，代表着他在两天时间内击杀了超过9000多只的丧尸。
这样的大佬实名冒头。
瞬间就将帖子热度顶到了最前面，仅次於花钱买了置顶的林羽帖子。
也因为此事，类似的事情在论坛上如雨後春笋般，霎时间纷纷冒了出来。
【红色属性果换取大佬救命！！！】
又是一贴红色属性果交易贴。
“楼主，红色属性果那麽珍贵，你怎麽舍得给别人啊？不会是骗人的吧？”
“就是，红色的你会拿出来？是我直接吸收了它不香吗？”
“我靠，你们以为我愿意啊？关键就算是力量果实，我吃了也活不了啊！”
贴主在下面焦急的回复。
“楼主瞎吹吧，红色属性果可是能+50点属性的，50点力量加上去，瞬间变成大高手，丧尸什麽的都是土鸡瓦狗！”
“你们懂个der啊，我躲在动物园旁边一个仓库里，外面全是一堆变异的老虎狮子大象什麽的，你确定50点力量能杀出去？”
楼主这话一出，评论区一阵寂静。
“楼主保重！”
“楼主保重！”
评论区霎时间被这句话刷屏了。
突然，一条评论出现。
“我是妖，和你在一个动物园，发具体地址来，我救你！记住，红色属性果！”
又是一位大佬现身。
进化点榜排名第五。
这一夜，林羽睡得很香，主要是昨晚折腾得太累了。
不知道是不是刘诗韵的原因，陈静儿特别卖力，让他体验到了很多。
什麽阿威十八式
啧啧！
你们想象不到。
吃过东西，林羽带着几人一如往常的走出了酒店。
不过这一次，小队里面多了两人。
刘诗韵和他女儿刘茹可。
“叔叔，我们是要去打怪兽吗？”
“姐姐，你是不是特别厉害？”
“我也要打怪兽，我要保护妈妈！”
小丫头路上叽叽喳喳，很是活跃，并没有太多的恐惧和害怕。
content_en:
Divine Punishment, the 9th strongest one on the evolution point list.
Reaching the ultra-high evolution point of 9127 means that he killed more than 9,000 zombies in two days.
Such a big boss appears under his real name.
In an instant, the post's popularity reached the top, second only to Lin Yu's post that he spent money to pin to the top.
Because of this incident, similar things sprung up on the forum, and they popped up all of a sudden.
[Red attribute fruit is exchanged for help from the boss! ! ! 】
Another red attribute fruit trading post.
"Master, the red attribute fruit is so precious, why are you willing to give it to others? It can't be a lie, right?"
"That's it, will you take out the red one? Is it not fragrant because I absorbed it directly?"
"Holy crap, do you think I'm willing? The key is even if it's a power fruit, I won't be able to survive after eating it!"
The poster replied anxiously below.
"The poster is just bragging. The red attribute fruit can increase attributes by 50 points. If you add 50 points of strength, you will instantly become a master. Zombies and other things are just chickens and dogs!"
"You know what, I'm hiding in a warehouse next to the zoo. There are a bunch of mutated tigers, lions, elephants, etc. outside. Are you sure you can kill me with 50 points of strength?"
As soon as the original poster said this, there was a silence in the comment area.
"Lord, take care!"
"Lord, take care!"
The comment section was instantly flooded with this sentence.
Suddenly, a comment appeared.
"I am a demon. I am in the same zoo with you. Send me your specific address and I will save you! Remember, red attribute fruit!"
Another big boss showed up.
Ranked fifth on the evolution point list.
This night, Lin Yu slept soundly, mainly because he was too tired from last night.
I don’t know if it was because of Liu Shiyun, but Chen Jing’er worked particularly hard and allowed him to experience a lot.
What Awei's Eighteen Styles
Tsk tsk!
You can't imagine it.
After eating, Lin Yu led a few people out of the hotel as usual.
But this time, there were two more people in the team.
Liu Shiyun and his daughter Liu Ruke.
"Uncle, are we going to fight monsters?"
"Sister, are you particularly powerful?"
"I also want to fight monsters, and I want to protect my mother!"
The little girl was chattering on the road and was very active, without too much fear or fear.
